research_style_2025.note: rows where research/soccer/props_soccer.py build() also produces a row

meta.population: starters with > 0 minutes who pass the live board's gates: >= 3 match-day squads in the live season form, start rate >= 0.5, latest team = this team, both teams >= 3 games
meta.outcome: 1+ non-own goal in regulation time (incl. stoppage; extra time excluded)

hybrid.formula: p = sigmoid(intercept + sum(coef_i * x_i)); x = [logit(model goal1 p), logit(sim p), ln(team expected goals), m_start]

sim.minute_weights: src/lib/ucl-sim.json buckets (45' and 90' carry stoppage time)
sim.team_goals: cross-league Elo (research/ucl tuned_params.json) -> per-league Poisson GLM on gap/400, 5 previous seasons, + Dixon-Coles rho

first_goal.definition: first goal of the match in regulation time (incl. stoppage, extra time excluded); own goal first or 0-0 -> no player wins
first_goal.population: same candidates as the anytime backtest

anytime_domestic.ship: hybrid (pooled over the five leagues; per-league intercepts added nothing in 2024-25 CV)
steps: 1. Fix the live feature port of the shipped goal1 model so it matches what the coefficients were fitted on: player totals accumulated over all seasons since 2021-22 (not this season only), the prior season as before, and position/formation place from the player's lineup slot (this match once lineups post; else his last STARTING slot, never 'SUB'). Same coefficients, no refit: 2025-26 log loss 0.26792 -> 0.26498, AUC 0.7636 -> 0.7728.
2. Stack it with the simulator's closed form (on-pitch share x m_start) in the hybrid logistic below (hybrid_research coefficients if step 1 is done, hybrid_live otherwise).

3. Optional upgrade: the gradient-boosted model (gbm) was best in every league on 2025-26 but needs a tree exporter (cf. src/lib/cfb-td-forest.*); its edge over the step-2 hybrid is ~0.001 log loss (CI just excludes 0; Brier CI includes 0).

hybrid_live.formula: p = sigmoid(intercept + sum(coef_i * x_i)); x = [logit(model goal1 p), logit(sim p), ln(team expected goals), m_start]

sim_inputs.minute_weights: src/lib/ucl-sim.json buckets (45' and 90' carry stoppage time)
sim_inputs.team_goals: cross-league Elo (research/ucl tuned_params.json) -> per-league Poisson GLM on gap/400, 5 previous seasons, + Dixon-Coles rho

anytime_ucl.ship: replace the site's scorer shares in the simulator's scorer markets with the on-pitch share x m_start for announced starters (sim_on); gbm_lite is better still if a tree model is shipped
anytime_ucl.why: the site's shares are per team goal over the whole squad, so the XI's shares sum to ~0.53 while starters score ~0.82 of a team's goals: every starter is under-priced by ~35%

first_goal.ship_domestic: hybrid_first (logistic on the anytime model, the closed-form sim, team/opp xG, m_start)
first_goal.ship_ucl: sim_first closed form with on-pitch shares (sim_stack_first is a statistical tie)
first_goal.closed_form: P(first) = lam_t/(lam_t+lam_o) * (1 - exp(-(lam_t+lam_o))) * s, s = on-pitch share x m_start; matches the engine at 100k sims (mean |diff| ~0.001)

recommendation.engine: closed forms are preferred: the engine at 100k gives the same first-goal probabilities and the same top pick in ~99% of matches; for anytime it plays ~7.6% more goals than the expected goals it is given on domestic fixtures, which lifts anytime probabilities ~7%; 1k sims change the top pick in 8-15% of matches
